title: Symphonia (Riesencodex facsimile)
author: Hildegard of Bingen
description: A facsimile from the Wiesbaden Riesencodex showing Hildegard of Bingen’s Latin sacred songs with their original musical notation.
editionNote: Manuscript Hs. 2, the Wiesbaden Riesencodex. Symphonia section from the digital collection of Hochschul- und Landesbibliothek RheinMain.
